Mid-morning, some useful tips for returning guests
It concerns the desk
Travelers, check the rules for companion animals before you arrive.

Aurelia Skyways
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Bring your papers, keep your pet secure, and follow staff directions at the counter. <<FACT F055>> Use a crate that gives the animal enough space to stand, turn, and settle calmly. <<FACT F067>> If anything feels unclear, the desk will listen carefully and help you prepare the trip with care.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance before departure.
